ibs.name: Irritable Bowel Syndrome
ibs.description: A common functional bowel disorder causing pain, bloating, and changes in bowel habits.
dietaryTips: Avoid gas-producing foods (legumes, onions, raw garlic)
herbalSuggestions: Talbina (barley flour) — Calms the digestive system
Chamomile — Antispasmodic and anti-inflammatory
Peppermint — Relieves abdominal pain and bloating
Ginger — Digestion enhancer

migraine.name: Migraine
migraine.description: Severe, recurrent headaches, often on one side, which may be accompanied by nausea and light sensitivity.
dietaryTips: Avoid triggers: chocolate, aged cheese, excessive caffeine
Drink plenty of water to avoid dehydration
herbalSuggestions: Hijama (cupping) — One of the strongest remedies for headaches proven in the Sunnah
Olive oil — Rub on forehead and temples
Black seed — Anti-inflammatory
Peppermint (topical) — Relieves tension
lifestyleTips: Avoid sudden exposure to heat or cold

diabetes.name: Diabetes (Type 2)
diabetes.description: A chronic disorder of blood sugar regulation. Requires ongoing management in consultation with a doctor.
dietaryTips: Avoid canned juices and soft drinks
herbalSuggestions: Black seed — Studies have shown its effectiveness in regulating blood sugar
Fenugreek — Lowers blood sugar (use with caution with medications)
Cinnamon — May improve insulin sensitivity
⚠ Warning: Do not stop your medications and consult your doctor

hair-loss.name: Hair Loss
hair-loss.description: Abnormal hair loss that may be due to iron deficiency, vitamin D deficiency, hormones, or stress.
dietaryTips: Vitamin D (sun exposure for 15 minutes daily)
herbalSuggestions: Sidr leaves — To strengthen the scalp and hair
Olive oil — To moisturize and nourish hair
Henna — Strengthens hair and treats the scalp
Black seed oil — Anti-inflammatory
lifestyleTips: Check iron, vitamin D, and thyroid levels

vitamin-d.name: Vitamin D Deficiency
vitamin-d.description: Very common in the Arab region despite the sun. Causes bone pain, fatigue, and weakened immunity.
dietaryTips: Supplements as directed by a doctor
herbalSuggestions: Cod liver oil — A natural source of vitamin D
Dates — Rich in supportive minerals
Honey — Supports immunity
lifestyleTips: Best time: early morning or before sunset
Check vitamin D levels every 6 months

hemorrhoids.name: Hemorrhoids
hemorrhoids.description: Swelling in the veins of the rectum and anus. Common and bothersome, but usually treatable.
dietaryTips: Drink at least 8 glasses of water daily
herbalSuggestions: Honey — Topically as a soothing and anti-inflammatory agent
Olive oil — Natural laxative and moisturizer
Hijama (cupping) — May be beneficial in some cases
Aloe vera gel — Topical soothing agent
lifestyleTips: Do not strain during bowel movements
Warm water bath (Sitz bath) for 15 minutes
